Name: Oil
Description:
Oil acts as a second currency (like IPCs) BUT: it is mainly used for operations (movement/combat), not required to be transported, stored and spent nationally. Oil can be derived from oil producing territories via Oil Derricks or seazones via Oil Platform or by developing a Synthetic Oil Plant. Japan starts with 1 oil in the bank.
Oil costs: Land: 1 oil per major offensive Air: 1 oil per battle Naval: 1 oil per fleet per turn (+1 if combat).
Penalties (when out of oil): Tanks/mech → no blitz Aircraft → -1 attack Navy → cannot enter hostile zones.
Rules: Production From territories + infrastructure Collected during income phase Max storage: 15 (soft cap at 10, after 10 lose 1 oil each turn). )Convoys → lose IPC OR oil and Bombing → disables oil structures. Emergency Rule: Replace Oil cost by 3 times the amount in IPC.

Name: Aluminium
Description: Aluminium is produced in an Aluminium Factory and when transported to an industrial complex you get a discount of 2 IPC when building a Jet, Rocket or Flying Fortress.

Name: Vril
Description: Vril energy acts as currency for the use of German Occult Artifacts (GOA) and are produced by the Ahnenerbe Institute one each turn.

Name: Steel
Description: Steel is produced in a Steel Factory and when transported to an industrial compllex you get a discount of 2 IPC when building a Super Submarine, Heavy Tank or Heavy Capital ship.

Name: Uranium
Description: Resource mined from 1 of 5 fixed Uranium mines: Western United States, Slovakia, Belgian Congo, Yukon Territory. Cannot be build. Production is 1 per turn.

Name: Heavy Water
Description: Resource produced in a Heavy Water Plant: two exist at the start of the game: Norway, Ukraine. More can be build.
